text: Frontline safety work shouldn't live in text threads, spreadsheets, and binders. Reldro connects it all, from the first report to a fix that's verified, in one place.

It starts with the person who sees the problem. On their phone, a worker picks what they're reporting, describes it in their own words or by voice, adds photos, and decides whether to share their name. No training needed.
The safety team sees every site in one queue. Serious incidents open a response workspace right away, and late or unowned reports are flagged, so nothing waits unseen.
Investigations look at conditions, not blame. Capture the facts and the timeline, pick the contributing factors, and turn what you learn into a lesson crews can use tomorrow.
Every corrective action has an owner, a due date, and a status. And it isn't done until someone verifies the fix.
Inspections, toolbox talks, and certifications live in the same system. See who still needs to acknowledge a talk, and which required certifications are missing or about to expire.
Zoom out to every site at a glance, with what needs attention, what's overdue, and when the next inspection is due.
Reldro. One connected workflow for frontline safety, from report to verified fix. Book a demo to see it with your own sites.
